operational.description: Repository availability and observable default-branch automation health.

governance.description: Portfolio review, status-declaration, lifecycle, and repository identity governance checks.

assurance.description: Substantive conformance, risk, control, and assurance evidence is not yet ingested by this monitor.

cross_specification.description: Cross-specification pressure-test evidence is not yet ingested by this monitor.

findings.subject: .github/workflows/cross-spec-pressure-test.yml
findings.claim: The latest completed default-branch run for this workflow is failing within the governed observation window.
findings.recommended_action: Review the failed workflow, restore a successful default-branch run, or record an explicit accepted-risk disposition.

remediation.objective: Restore a successful latest completed default-branch run for the affected workflow or record an explicit repository-governed risk disposition.
acceptance_criteria: The affected workflow's latest completed default-branch run succeeds, or an explicit governed disposition supersedes the operational expectation.
verification: Run the affected workflow on the default branch.
Rerun the portfolio monitor and confirm the stable finding fingerprint is no longer open.

handoff.intended_use: Supply this dossier with the affected repository source during remediation planning and implementation.
handoff.closure_rule: A finding is closed only when a later monitor run no longer observes the condition and records closure evidence in the lifecycle registry.
